summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Caribbean fruit e-commerce site iteration 4. Backend APIs show excellent performance (96.8% success rate) with functional email subscription, discount validation, checkout, and game features. Frontend loads correctly with working store and game functionality. Product sync issue identified where only 4 products are returned instead of expected 13.

critical_bugs.issue: Returns only 4 products instead of expected 13 after MongoDB sync
critical_bugs.impact: Product catalog incomplete - affects store functionality

ui_bugs.issue: /game route returns 404 - game is accessible through homepage but not direct URL

integration_issues.issue: Email capture modal may not be triggering properly from homepage

action_item_for_main_agent: Fix product catalog sync issue: /api/products endpoint returns only 4 products instead of 13 despite successful MongoDB sync. Individual product slug endpoints work correctly, suggesting the issue is in the products list endpoint implementation. Also fix /game route 404 error for direct navigation.
